notes.title: Version 2.0.3 - Steam Screenshot Toggle
notes.content:
Hello Shutterbugs!

Another quick patch to round out release weekend: You can now disable photos being added to Steam screenshots automatically! Just in case you don't want them saved both on disk and in Steam.

Have a great rest of your weekend!

notes.title: Version 2.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello Shutterbugs! 

Thanks to your reports on the community Discord, I was able to fix some important issues:

- Playing with controller will no longer restart the island you are on everytime you interact with menus
- Photos will appear in the gallery again on OSX (you have lost no photos, check the "Open Photos Folder" in the gallery!)
- You'll find a handy link pointing you to the Steam community forums to easily see photos others have shared!

Thank you so much for playing the game, and for reaching out about issues!

notes.title: Shutter Stroll is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Shutterbugs!

It is finally time: I am proud to finally give Shutter Stroll into your hands. It's been an immense joy working on the game, and I am so happy to finally give you the ability to explore its islands. To mark the occasion, the game is 10% off for a week! 

I'm looking forward for seeing your photos, make sure to share them on social media (using the hashtag #ShutterStroll) or the community hub! ✨

Thank you so much for sticking around for the release, it means the world to me. Also, please make sure to give the game a review once you've played it a bit, it makes a huge difference in terms of visibility, and I'd love to hear what you think!

See you on the islands!
Jannik ✨

notes.title: Shutter Stroll releases September 6th!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tXEoXCEIaPI;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings, Shutterbugs!

The wait is finally over! In just about a month Shutter Stroll will release here on Steam! I am beyond proud to finally bring the game to you all, it's been a wild ride leading up to here, and I cannot await the day you start sharing your photos with each other. Please make sure to wishlist the game to not miss its release!

To commemorate the occasion, please enjoy this trailer featuring music by the talented [url=https://soundcloud.com/adibabidan]adibabidan[/url]. It's been wonderful working with them on the trailer, there's no one that could better capture the vibes of the game.

So, prep your boat! We're arriving on the islands September 6th!

See you between the monoliths! ✨

notes.title: Shutter Stroll is coming to the Next Fest! 📸🏝
notes.content:
It's finally time! You'll be able to play the Shutter Stroll Demo this Next Fest! 📸

The demo build will let you visit three islands, generated [i]specifically [/i]for you! Plus, come back [b]each day [/b]to find another new island ready to be photographed, and grab some snaps before it disappears into the aether forever. 🌙

[h3]When?[/h3]
The demo launches [b]June 14th[/b]! I know some of you can't wait for it, so it'll unlock a few days ahead of Next Fest!

[h3]Where?[/h3]
You can play the demo right here on Steam, and share your photos in the Steam Community — or on our [url=https://discord.link/ShutterStroll]Discord[/url]! I'm looking forward to seeing your snapshots!

[h3]What comes after?[/h3]
Make sure to wishlist the game for when it comes out on Steam later this year, with all new features such as:
[list]
[*] A vastly expanded island generator.
[*] Even more camera options, to make each shot your own.
[*] Upgraded visuals.
[*] And as always, a near infinite amount of islands to discover and explore.
[/list]
